discriminating_case: A command passes with a home-only configuration, then the cold trial rejects its undeclared dependency.
mechanism: Run the same native check against complete disposable Git clones, with separate home/cache locations and exact source identity.
limitations: One observed upstream CI trial, not a statistical speed comparison.
PATH/base tooling and host capabilities remain; this is not a security sandbox or a clean operating-system image.
Local Git transport; remote authentication and IDE synchronization are not tested.
No actual model/IDE minor-feature, dependency-installation or deployed-product acceptance is established.
No token-usage measurement or numerical savings claim.
followup: Bind the helper to an adopter's actual native source-only check and require its own executed evidence; never transfer this pass to another repository by copying files.
